kpis.description_fr: ASMs = capacite totale (un siege transporte un mille). Metrique de reference capacite aerienne, retour quasi pre-COVID.
kpis.description_en: ASMs = total capacity (one seat flown one mile). Reference airline capacity metric, near pre-COVID level.

kpis.description_fr: Load Factor = RPMs / ASMs. Baisse FY25 (-3 pts) signal demande / mix offre degrade vs concurrents.
kpis.description_en: Load Factor = RPMs / ASMs. FY25 decline (-3 pts) signals demand / supply mix weakening vs peers.

kpis.description_fr: RASM (cents par siege-mile) : revenu genere par chaque unite de capacite. Stagnation FY25 vs FY23 = pression pricing.
kpis.description_en: RASM (cents per seat-mile): revenue per capacity unit. FY25 stagnation vs FY23 = pricing pressure.

kpis.description_fr: CASM (cents par siege-mile) : cout unitaire, ex-carburant 12.44 (+3.2%). Inflation salaires/maintenance pression.
kpis.description_en: CASM (cents per seat-mile): unit cost, ex-fuel 12.44 (+3.2%). Wage/maintenance inflation pressure.

kpis.description_fr: RPMs = trafic payant (passagers x distance). Recul FY25 -2.2% : signal de demande faiblissante apres pic 2024.
kpis.description_en: RPMs = paid traffic (passengers x distance). FY25 -2.2% decline signals softening demand after 2024 peak.

kpis.description_fr: Yield = revenu passager par RPM (cents). Croissance FY25 +4.4% : seul levier prix reel face a dilution mix.
kpis.description_en: Yield = passenger revenue per RPM (cents). FY25 +4.4% growth: real pricing lever amid mix dilution.

_notes: Reconstruit chunk-6 mission #20 : 5-6 ans 2020-2025 depuis 10-Ks officiels. Airline KPIs canoniques (ASMs/RPMs/Load Factor/RASM/CASM/Yield) = standard sector aviation.
